entry.description: Generate a Java exercise from your brief, with a problem statement, starter code, sample solution, and tests.

brief.intro: AI creates a problem statement, starter code, sample solution, and tests from your description.
brief.consequences: Creates an unreleased draft. Allow about {{min}}–{{max}} minutes, then review it before release.
brief.label: What should students learn and build?
brief.hint: Describe the learning objective, what learners already know, what code should be provided, and what they should write themselves. Include required behaviour and constraints.
brief.setupFailed: Artemis could not create the draft exercise. Your description is still here, so you can try again.
brief.startFailed: Your draft exercise was created, but generation did not start. Nothing has been generated yet.
brief.deleteFailed: The draft exercise could not be deleted. Open it from the exercise list and delete it there.
brief.preparing: Preparing the exercise from your brief…

activity.stalledOffline: No update for {{duration}} — the connection to the run was lost

usage.title: Cost and usage
usage.incompleteHint: Some of this run's model calls could not be accounted for. Everything below is a lower bound — the run cost at least this much, not nothing.
usage.costPartialHint: Some responses used a model with no configured price, so the real cost is higher.
usage.notPricedHint: No price is configured for a model this run used, so Artemis cannot estimate what it cost.
usage.budgetAriaLabel: Share of the token budget this run has used
usage.noBudget: tokens charged — this Artemis server sets no token ceiling for a run.

run.newRunHint: Enter the brief or feedback for this new run. Previous instructions and selected review comments are not carried over.
run.title: Generate exercise
run.otherInstructor: Another instructor started this run. You can follow it, but only they can cancel it.
run.statusUnavailable: The generation status could not be loaded. Nothing has been changed in your exercise.
run.notStartedTitle: No generation has run for this exercise
run.notStartedHint: Generating writes a problem statement, starter code, a sample solution and tests into this exercise. It takes about 10 to 25 minutes and uses a large language model.
run.stillRunningOnServer: The run itself is still going on the server. Only this page cannot read its status right now.
run.notStartedWhoCanAct: An instructor or editor of this course can start a generation.
run.stalledAnnouncement: No update for {{minutes}} minutes. The run is still connected.
run.stalledOfflineAnnouncement: No update for {{minutes}} minutes, and the status of the run could not be read.

live.repairRound: Review round {{round}} — {{blocking}} to fix, {{advisory}} to look at ({{carriedOver}} carried over, {{drained}} resolved, {{fresh}} new)
live.checkpoint: A working version is secured. Even if the rest fails, you get an exercise.

artifacts.title: Exercise materials
artifacts.notSavedHint: File activity describes this run’s working material. The run outcome shows whether it was saved.
artifacts.savedHint: Saved to the exercise. Open the code editor to review and edit the result.
artifacts.specPendingHint: Artemis is still deciding what to build.
artifacts.statementPendingHint: Artemis writes it near the end of the design stage.
artifacts.filesPendingHint: They appear here as Artemis writes them.
artifacts.filesNoneHint: This run ended before it wrote anything into the repositories.
artifacts.notKeptHint: This run ended without producing one, or without keeping a copy of it.
artifacts.loadFailed: The retained draft could not be loaded.

content.selectTitle: Pick a file to read it
content.selectHint: Choose a file from the list to see what Artemis wrote into it.
content.deletedHint: There is nothing to read. Deleting a file is a normal part of reworking a draft.
content.emptyFileHint: Artemis wrote it without any content.
content.failedTitle: The file could not be loaded
content.failedHint: The retained draft could not be fetched. Nothing in your exercise was changed.
content.pendingRunTitle: Contents are not available while the run is going
content.pendingRunHint: Artemis reports which files it writes, but cannot serve their contents until the run has finished.
content.savedTitle: This file is in your exercise
content.savedHint: Artemis saved the run into the repositories. Open the code editor to read the file as it was stored.
content.notRetainedTitle: This run kept no copy of its files
content.notRetainedHint: Only the list of what it wrote survives. Run again to produce a draft you can read.

review.currentContent: Current repository contents. These may include edits made after generation; this is not a frozen run snapshot.
review.compareHint: Check that the difference practises the intended skill, not unrelated boilerplate.
review.direction: Student template → reference solution. Added code is work the learner is expected to write.
review.missing: File not found in the current repository
review.missingHint: It may have been removed or renamed since this run. Open the repository to inspect its current files.
review.templateMissing: This file is absent from the template. Check that creating the type is part of the learning objective.
review.solutionMissing: This file is absent from the solution. Review whether its removal is intended.

outcome.savedBody: The sample solution passes all {{testCount}} tests and the starter code fails them, as it should. Review the problem statement and the tests before you release the exercise.
outcome.reviewBody: Artemis saved the draft, but not every check came back clean. Open the code editor, fix what the findings point at, then release.
outcome.partialTitle: Only part of the draft was saved
outcome.partialBody: The write-out did not finish cleanly. Open the code editor to see what is there before you run again.
outcome.failedBody: Nothing was written to your exercise.
outcome.cancelledBody: Nothing was written to your exercise. The draft exercise is still there and empty — run it again or delete it.
outcome.retained: The work Artemis had done is kept so you can look at it. It is not part of your exercise.
outcome.nothingRetained: Nothing from this run could be kept, so there is nothing to inspect. Your exercise is unchanged — run it again when you are ready.
outcome.disclaimer: Generated with AI. Check the problem statement, the tests, and the sample solution before releasing this exercise.

verdict.title: Checks
verdict.solutionFails: Sample solution does not pass the tests
verdict.templateFails: Starter code fails the tests, as it should
verdict.templatePasses: Starter code passes tests it should fail
verdict.consistencyPassed: Build and grading consistency checks passed
verdict.consistencyFailed: Build or grading consistency checks failed

terminationReason.REPAIR_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: Artemis ran out of repair attempts before every check passed.
terminationReason.ATTEMPT_CAP_REACHED: Artemis reached the maximum number of attempts for one run.
terminationReason.MECHANICAL_REPAIR_EXHAUSTED: Artemis could not get the exercise to build and grade correctly within its repair budget.
terminationReason.POST_REPAIR_CORRECTION_EXHAUSTED: Artemis ran out of attempts to correct the last round of review findings.
terminationReason.NO_SCHEDULABLE_SURFACE: There was nothing left that Artemis was allowed to change.
terminationReason.REVIEW_UNAVAILABLE: The quality review could not run.
terminationReason.UNCHANGED_CANDIDATE_RESUBMITTED: A repair attempt changed nothing, so Artemis stopped rather than repeat itself.
terminationReason.REPAIR_DID_NOT_IMPROVE: The repair attempts stopped making the exercise better.
terminationReason.NO_ADMISSIBLE_CONCEPT: Artemis could not find an exercise design that fits your description.
terminationReason.CONCEPT_ADMITTED_WITH_FINDINGS: Artemis went ahead with the best design it found, but had reservations about it.
terminationReason.DEADLINE_EXCEEDED: The run hit its time limit.
terminationReason.TOKEN_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED: The run hit its budget limit.
terminationReason.AGENT_ERROR: The AI model failed while working on the exercise.
terminationReason.ENVIRONMENT_UNAVAILABLE: The build environment was not available.

actions.cancelConfirmMessage: Artemis stops immediately and nothing is written to your exercise. The exercise stays as it is.

blocker.requiresEditor: You need editor rights in this course to change the exercise with AI.
blocker.unsupportedLanguage: AI authoring supports Java exercises only.
blocker.unsupportedProjectType: This Java exercise builds with Maven or another tool. AI authoring only verifies Gradle builds; the build tool cannot be changed after creation, so create a Gradle exercise to use it.
blocker.examExercise: AI authoring is not available for exam exercises.
blocker.staticCodeAnalysis: Disable static code analysis in the exercise settings first. The AI verifier does not model its penalties.
blocker.sequentialTestRuns: Disable sequential test runs in the exercise settings first. The AI verifier runs all tests in one pass.
blocker.auxiliaryRepositories: Remove the auxiliary repositories first. AI authoring writes only the template, solution, and test repositories.
blocker.released: This exercise is already released. Move its release date into the future first; AI authoring only changes exercises students cannot see yet.
blocker.studentParticipations: Students have already started this exercise. AI authoring only changes exercises without participations.
blocker.problemStatementBusy: Wait for the current problem statement refinement to finish.
blocker.consistencyCheckBusy: Wait for the current consistency check to finish.
blocker.repositorySetupBusy: Wait until the repository operation has finished.

jobs.label: AI generation
jobs.title: AI generation runs
jobs.emptyHint: A run appears here as soon as you start one from an exercise.
jobs.loadFailed: The generation runs could not be loaded.

generationActivity.title: Generation activity
generationActivity.runningByAnotherInstructor: Generation is running for another instructor…
generationActivity.meaningfulSpecRequired: Describe the exercise requirements in at least 40 characters before generating it.
generationActivity.saveChangesFirst: Save or discard your local edits before starting or applying AI generation.
generationActivity.refreshBlockedByLocalEdits: The exercise was saved, but local edits prevent a safe refresh. Copy anything you need before reloading the saved exercise.
generationActivity.refreshingEditor: Updating the editor with the saved exercise…
generationActivity.editorRefreshFailed: The exercise was saved, but the editor could not be updated safely. Copy anything you need before reloading the saved exercise.
generationActivity.reloadSavedExerciseConfirmMessage: Reloading replaces the editor with the saved exercise. All unsaved local edits will be lost.
generationActivity.statusUnavailable: The generation status could not be verified. AI actions and editing remain unavailable until the status check succeeds.
generationActivity.cancelFailed: The generation could not be cancelled. Its status was refreshed.
generationActivity.changedFilesNotNavigable: These open in the editor once the run has saved them into your exercise.
generationActivity.reviewSavedChangesHint: Open the exercise version history or the exact saved repository commit.
generationActivity.reviewBlockedByLocalEdits: Save or discard your local edits before opening the saved-change review.
generationActivity.reviewUnavailable: The saved Hyperion commit could not be found. Open the repository history and review the changes manually.
generationActivity.emptyTitle: No AI activity for this exercise yet
generationActivity.emptyHint: Start generation here or from the Artemis Intelligence menu.
generationActivity.unavailableHint: Generation is unavailable after release or student participation.

persistence.workingCopy: Draft in progress — nothing saved to your exercise yet
persistence.saved: Saved to exercise — ready for instructor review
persistence.savedNeedsReview: Saved to exercise — instructor review required
persistence.partial: Not fully saved — manual review required

generationActivity.revertPartialFailed: The AI changes could not be fully undone. Reverted repositories: {{repositories}}. Review the remaining repositories manually.
generationActivity.undoGenerationTooltip: Restore the exercise to the state before the most recent saved generation.
generationActivity.undoAdaptationTooltip: Restore the exercise to the state before the most recent saved adaptation.
generationActivity.undoGenerationConfirmHeader: Undo the most recent saved generation?
generationActivity.undoGenerationConfirmMessage: This restores the problem statement and repositories to their state before generation. You cannot restore the generated version afterward.
generationActivity.undoAdaptationConfirmHeader: Undo the most recent saved adaptation?
generationActivity.undoAdaptationConfirmMessage: This restores the problem statement and repositories to their state before adaptation. You cannot restore the adapted version afterward.
generationActivity.generateConfirmHeader: Generate and automatically save this exercise?
generationActivity.generateConfirmMessage: Hyperion will replace the problem statement, template, solution, and tests after mechanical verification, then save the result automatically. Automated quality findings will appear as review comments. Review every artifact before release. Undo is temporary, stored only in memory, and becomes unavailable after conflicting repository changes or a server restart.

workers.title: AI generations
workers.description: Generation and adaptation share bounded worker slots. One isolated worker can run several exercises at once; each exercise still allows only one active AI run.
workers.loadFailed: Worker status could not be refreshed. Previously loaded entries may be stale. Generation may also be disabled on this node.
workers.snapshotHint: Refreshes every 15 seconds while this page is visible. Free slots are an admission snapshot, not a reservation or throughput guarantee. CPU, memory and provider limits still apply.
workers.empty: No generation workers are configured. Configure worker identities and start their services to provide capacity.
workers.retainedReservations: {{ count }} offline worker(s) still hold a core reservation. Inspect the execution and ownership before recovery; do not treat these slots as available.
workers.noActiveRuns: No generation or adaptation is currently running.
workers.cancelHint: Cancel an individual run, not the worker. Other exercises keep running. Once saving starts, cancellation is no longer safe.
workers.savingHint: Repository changes are being saved. Wait for this phase to finish.
workers.cancellingHint: The worker is stopping this run and cleaning up its sandbox.
workers.cancelConfirmation: Cancel the active AI run for exercise #{{ exerciseId }}? Unsaved work will not be applied. Other runs are unaffected.
workers.cancelReason: Reason (recorded in the administrator audit log)
workers.cancelFailed: Cancellation was not accepted. The run may have finished or started saving. Refresh the overview; your reason is retained.
